Commentary.Commentary: There were no significant partnerships barring one between Williamson and Nicholls which provided some resistance. Once Nicholls and the skipper departed, no one else could hold the fort and New Zealand were bowled out for the lowest first innings total in Abu Dhabi. As for the Pakistani bowlers, Yasir Shah was the pick of them with three wickets, 3 others picking a brace and Bilal getting one of his own. Tea was pushed ahead and now has been taken at the fall of the last wicket of the first innings. New Zealand can gather themselves in the break and will be hoping to pick some quick wickets in the final session or else Pakistan would be out of sight on Day 1 itself.

Fantastic work by Pakistan! This isn't what they would've expected after Williamson won the toss and decided to bat. They would've been looking towards a long toiling day on the field (given the track looked a batting beauty) but the New Zealand innings just capitulated in the post-Lunch session. Once their skipper departed after a well-made 63, the Pakistani spinners just raced through the lower middle order. Disappointing that innings didn't even last for 70 overs.

OUT! What a bizarre end to the innings that promised a lot when the Kiwi captain and Nicholls were batting before the lunch break. It has come to an immature end as they have lost 7 wickets in this session. Coming to the ball, Yasir had changed his angle to over the wicket for this delivery, lands it on middle. Ajaz shoulders his arms playing for the turn but the ball holds its line and hits him on his pads bang on middle. Umpire has no hesitation in raising his finger. New Zealand all out for 153!
Outside off and the ball turns in again, Ajaz plays it down the ground on the leg side.
Outside off and turning in, Ajaz defends it toward mid-wicket.
Flatter and quicker at the pads, Boult plays it towards square leg.
FOUR! Flighted outside off and Boult comes down the track and hits it over the bowler's head for four runs.
Flatter and turning into the pads, Boult works it down on the leg side.
Full and outside off again, Boult smothers the spin by coming ahead.
Full and outside off, Boult comes ahead and defends.
Trent Boult is the last batsman for New Zealand. Should have been Tea now, but since just one wicket is remaining, the session has been extended by 30 minutes.

OUT! Caught by Asad Shafiq at first slip. New Zealand lose their ninth wicket! Looped up outside off and this was always coming. Had been beating the outside edge consistently over the past two or three overs. Deserved the wicket and gets it finally. Wagner wants to prod ahead and defend but it takes the edge for an easy catch.
Presses forward to a full ball and defends it again to end the over.
Shout for an lbw, not given! A leg spinner landing outside off and turning back in sharply. Patel fails to defend and is hit on the pads. Turning too much, feels the umpire.
Floated full ball on off, Patel lunges in defense.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flatter and on off, defended off the back foot.
Tossed up ball on off, turning back in, Ajaz defends it off his front foot.
Good ball! The ball is flighted and turns again, the batsman comes ahead to play at it but is beaten by the spin on the ball.
Flatter and quicker on off, Wagner goes back and punches it back towards mid off.
Shorter in length again, Wagner plays it to the point fielder off his back foot.

OUCH! The ball is short and outside off, Wagner goes back and cuts it. It hits the silly point fielder on his knee as he tries to move away. Must've hurt but he's okay to continue, without any treatment. Just rubs his knee and good to go.
Beaten again! Draws Wagner ahead and beats his outside edge with the turn. Unlucky not to get the edge.
Shorter and quicker outside off, Wagner pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Flatter ball, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flighted on middle, Patel flicks the ball onto the leg side but straight to the fielder.
Well outside off and turns in, Ajaz goes back in his crease and defends with a straight bat.
Quicker ball at the pads, flicked away to square leg. Ajaz thinks about the single but decides against it in the end.
Shorter this time and enough time for Wagner to pull it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Around the wicket, the ball lands outside off and turns in, Wagner defends on the back foot.
Yasir Shah returns in the attack.
Shoulders his arms for the third delivery in a row outside off.
Again left alone by the batsman as the ball was way outside off.
Way outside off and full, Ajaz lets it go through.
Flatter delivery this time outside off, punched to cover point and a quick run taken.
BEATEN BY THE SPIN! Full and flighted outside off, Wagner is drawn ahead for the defensive shot but the ball turns away and misses the outside edge.
Looped up and turning away outside off, Wagner stays back and punches it to cover.
Flatter and quicker on the pads this time, Ajaz flicks it to short leg.
Around the wicket, flighted and on middle, Ajaz gets his bat ahead to defend it.
Full ball outside off again, Ajaz comes ahead and dead bats it.
A tad fuller this time, Ajaz drives to mid off.
Similar ball and similar shot played again.
Full and loopy outside off,  Ajaz comes ahead and defends.
Full and on the pads this time, Ajaz flicks it down to fine leg for three runs.
Arm ball this time, angling on the pads. Ajaz misses the flick and gets hit on the pad.
Flighted outside off, kept out on the front foot.
Fuller in length and Patel comes ahead to smother the spin.
Wide outside off and turning even more away, Ajaz lets it go.
Looped up outside off, Ajaz tries to drive but gets the outside edge onto the off side.
Bilal Asif is back into the attack.
Fuller and flighted outside off, Wagner prods ahead and defends it.
Flatter delivery this time, the batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, driven by Patel through the covers for another run.
Outside off and turns in a long way, Patel comes ahead and defends, but gets an inside edge that falls far away from short leg.
Flatter and quicker on off stump, Ajaz defends on the back foot.
Flighted outside off, turns in. Ajaz defends it well off the back foot onto the vacant leg side for a single.

DROPPED! Yasir was placed there for that particular reason and he has spilled it. Sarfraz cannot believe it. A short delivery again, Wagner takes on the challenge to pull but fails to middle his shot. Yasir is standing a few paces ahead of the rope in the deep square leg region but fails to grab a simple catch. A run for Wagner and he lives to fight another day.
Full and outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it safely.

In the air...in the air... safe! Ali digs in a short delivery from 'round the wicket, well-directed, Wagner takes his eyes off the ball as he attempts to wheel a pull shot. It takes the top edge of the bat and flies wide of the keeper for a couple again.
Edgy! Lands it on a length and outside off, holding its line, Wagner tries turning it on the leg side but it takes the outside half of his willow and runs wide of backward point for a brace.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Wagner defends it off his back foot.
Almost the same as the previous ball, Ajaz comes forward and plays the defense with the full face of the bat.
Again full and outside off, Ajaz comes well ahead and defends it into the ground.
Full and outside off, the batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter delivery outside off, turns into Patel who tries to flick it away on the leg side.
Flighted and lots of turn after landing outside off. It comes in to hit the batsman's pad and the ball lobs away to the off side.
Full and flighted outside off, Ajaz looks to play the drive but gets the inside edge on the bottom part of the bat. It goes on to hit the keeper's pads.
Another good ball, this one is slightly fuller of a good length and Wagner is defending it but the ball moves slightly to miss the edge.
Short of a good length and above the off pole, Wagner defends it off the back foot.
Overpitched outside off, Ajaz mistimes his drive towards cover. The batsmen run through for a quick single.
Fuller and on off, Ajaz plays it with a straight bat.
On a length outside off, Ajaz covers the swing this time and defends it on the back foot.
What a jaffa! Too good for a number 10 batsman. Lands on off stump and moves away after landing. Misses the outside edge by a whisker.
Quicker and full this time, Wagner plays the back foot punch to the off side at the last moment and doesn't connect well. No run to end yet another successful over for New Zealand.
Flighted on off, Wagner comes well ahead to play this with a straight bat.
Flatter and quicker on off this time, Wagner goes back and defends.
Fuller and outside off, Ajaz pushes it through the covers for a single.

Another huge appeal! The impact is surely outside off on this one. The ball pitches outside off and comes in a long way to hit Ajaz on the pads. But he had come a long way ahead and the impact is outside off.
Debutant Ajaz Patel is in next.

OUT! What a ripper! This ball lands on leg stump and turns enough to beat the bat of Watling who was on the back foot trying to defend this one onto the leg side. The Kiwi keeper is rapped on the pads, they appeal and the finger goes up one more time. Watling takes the DRS but to no avail. There are three reds on the Ball Tracker and the on-field decision remains. The last recognized batsman departs and New Zealand are in all sorts of trouble now.
BJ Watling has been given out leg before. The DRS has been taken. No choice, he has to take it upstairs. Height is the only thing that can save him.
Switched to 'round the wicket and lands it on a length outside off, Wagner defends it soundly to the off side.
Pitches it up and outside off, it's driven off the front foot through extra cover. The mid off fielder moves across to his left to stop the ball and they collect a run.
On a length around off, defended off the back foot to the off side.

Goes for the yorker this time but ends up serving a half-volley on off, Watling does well to work it wide of mid on for a couple of runs. Reverse swing is happening and Hasan is getting it in abundance.
Angling into the batsman, on middle and off, BJ covers the line and blocks it with a straight bat towards mid on.
Good length delivery on off, shaping back in, Watling stays back and defends it in the direction of the bowler.

Things are happening here! This ball pitches way outside off stump line and rips in. Takes the inside edge and onto the pads of Wagner who was playing a defensive shot on the back foot. Would've been a goner if not for the edge. On a hindsight it looks like the impact was outside off as well and a bit high too.
WOAH! Lots of spin on this one, starts outside off and ends way down the leg side. Wagner wants to flick it but the turn beats him completely. Good take by Sarfraz down the leg side.
Flatter and quicker this time on off, Wagner goes back and defends it with a straight bat.
Shorter and outside off, Wagner punches it square on the off side for a couple.
Fuller this time outside off, Wagner prods ahead and defends.
Over the wicker to Wagner, good ball turning into the batsman, Wagner defends on the back foot.
Short of a length and on off stump, Watling goes back in the crease and defends it.
Second bouncer of the over, Watling ducks under it safely.
Full and slightly moves in after landing, Watling plays it to mid on with a straight bat.
Length ball outside off, Watling wants to punch it through the off side but gets the inside half of the bat and the ball rolls to mid on.
Surprise bouncer there! Short and aimed at the head, Watling ducks under it and lets it go.
Good length ball on off stump, Watling defends it towards mid-wicket.
Neil Wagner is in next.

OUT! What a decision! Sodhi has to depart. New Zealand are now seven down and in danger to get bowled out under 150. A flighted delivery landing full around leg. It straightens a touch after hitting the deck as Sodhi tries to defend it near his front pad. As soon as the connection is made, Pakistan go up in a huge extended appeal for an lbw. They believe it's pad first and the umpire, after thinking for a while, raises his finger. Ish, however, feels that he has middled his shot and goes for the review. Time for the replays. It shows that the ball has brushed the bottom half of Sodhi's front pad before hitting the bat. Wow, Bruce Oxenford has the eyes of a hawk as he has spotted that in real time. Apart from that, everything is in line as the Ball Tracker has three reds. The decision remains as it is. Ish is on his bike home.
Ish Sodhi has been adjudged lbw! He immediately reviews. Looks quite adjacent but is there any bat?
Slower through the air, full and on middle, Sodhi gets forward and offers a straight bat in defense.
Shortish and on off, stroked off the back foot through covers for a run.
This one skids back in from around off, Watling blocks it solidly.
Flatter and bit shorter on off, BJ punches it off his back foot to mid off.
Flighted full ball on leg, Watling plays it out off his pads to mid-wicket.

FOUR RUNNING RUNS! This was an attempted yorker, Sodhi takes it on the full and pushes it down to long off where there is a huge gap. The ball rolls all along the ground but before it can reach the boundary the batsmen run all four.
Bouncer aimed at the head, Ish ducks under it and lets it go through to the keeper.
Full and on off stump again, Sodhi defends it with the full face of the bat again.
No hat-trick for Hasan. The ball is on a good length and on off stump, Ish Sodhi defends it well and back to the bowler.
Ish Sodhi to face the hat-trick ball.

OUT! Golden duck for Colin de Grandhomme. He gets a reverse swinging beauty on a good length, the first ball he faces. He is late on his defensive prod and gets hit on the pad in front of middle stump. There was no chance that was missing or going above the stumps. Colin asks Watling if he should go upstairs, but is smartly advised not to. Hasan Ali on a hat-trick!
Drinks break. Meanwhile, Colin de Grandhomme has joined Watling in the middle.

OUT! Pakistan have got another gift. Williamson and New Zealand will be really disappointed. The ball was a short one and going down leg, the Kiwi skipper was looking to pull it behind square leg but got some glove behind to Sarfraz. He was looking so good out there in the middle but had a minor lapse of concentration and thrown it away. It was going down leg and was an easy run-scoring opportunity. Huge wicket and Pakistan firmly in control now.
Shorter and on middle, Watling goes back and defends it showing the full face of the bat.
Full and at the pads, Williamson pushes it to square leg for a single. He wants two but then decides against it.
Flatter one fired at the pads, Watling turns it away behind square leg for a run.
Full and on middle, Watling's turn to defend now.
Short and outside off, cut away by the skipper to get a single.
Flighted on middle, Williamson prods forward and dead bats it.
Haris Sohail has been brought back into the attack. Not sure if it's needed, maybe to give a change of ends to his main bowlers.
Just short of a good length and comes in after landing, Watling defends it to mid on off the back foot.
Length ball well outside off, Watling shoulders his arms to this one.
Good length ball just outside off, Watling stays back and defends it with a straight bat.
FOUR! This ball is on a length and outside off, Watling plays it with soft hands and guides it to the third man boundary.
This one is short and outside off, Williamson pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, slight shape which is covered and defended on front foot by Kane.
Shorter this time, Watling stays back and defends it.
Fuller and angling in to middle, Watling drives to mid on.
Good length ball again outside off, Watling just keeps it out by playing it back straight.
This one skids after landing on a good length on off stump, Watling is quick to come ahead, stays down and defends it with ease.
Length delivery again on the top of off, Watling stays back to defend it straight.
Good length on off stump from Abbas again, Watling defends it on the front foot.
Full and angling into the pads, Watling tucks it away behind square on the leg side to get off the mark.

Beautiful shot from Williamson. Asad Shafiq gives chase and stops it just inside the boundary. Ball was on a good length and outside off, he drives it elegantly in the gap through the covers and picks up three runs.
Back to short of a good length on top of off, Williamson punches it back down the ground with a straight bat.
Length ball just outside off. Well judged leave by the skipper this time.
Slightly short of a good length, Williamson guides it toward gully.
Good length ball outside off, calmly defended into the ground on the off side by Kane.
Good length on off stump. Abbas is relentless, Watling defends it to mid off.
Fuller in length and on middle this time, Watling defends it to mid on.
A carbon copy of the previous delivery. And a similar shot played by the batsman as well.
Short and outside off, Watling defends on the back foot to cover.
Good yorker length delivery to welcome Watling to the crease. He defends it watchfully.
BJ Watling is the new batsman.

OUT! Caught by Sarfraz. Nothing shot from Nicholls, very minimal foot movement on this one. He just drives expansively from his crease and gets the outside edge which is safely pouched by a diving Sarfraz to his left. The ball was full and outside off and was actually a half volley begging to be put away, but instead Pakistan have been presented with a wicket. The 72-run stand has been broken and Henry will be gutted with the way he threw away his wicket.
Good length and on off stump, Kane goes back and defends it back to the bowler.
FOUR! The ball is short and outside off, this is a great cut shot behind point for a boundary from the New Zealand captain.
This one is on a similar length but comes in slightly after landing. Kane watchfully lets it go through to the keeper.
Outside off stump and slightly fuller than good length, Kane decides to leave it alone.
Full and outside off, Nicholls drives it between point and cover and the fielder dives and stops it just in front of the boundary. Three runs have been picked up.
Around the wicket to the lefty, outside off and on a good length. The ball shapes away slightly after landing. Nicholls leaves it alone.
Hasan Ali is back into the attack.
Length ball outside off again, Kane is slightly ahead and defends it toward point.
Good length ball on off stump, Williamson shows off his textbook back foot defense again.
Good length ball a bit wide outside off, Williamson shoulders his arms to it.
Similar delivery but the bounce is true this time. Kane defends it straight back to the bowler.
What happened there? Kept a little low after bouncing on a length outside off. Kane was trying to defend it but it took the inside edge and fell down on the leg side.
Good length on off stump, Williamson presents the full face of the bat as he defends it.
Full and outside off from around the wicket to Nicholls. He comes ahead and dead bats it.
Short and outside off, Williamson just pushes it away to sweeper cover for a single.
Looped up full outside off, Kane drives it through extra cover for another couple.
Full and flighted, Kane covers the spin and keeps it out.

50 up for Williamson! He is such a consistent performer. The ball is short and wide outside off, Williamson just dabs it behind point and comes back for two. Making batting look very easy here. It is his 27th fifty in Test cricket. He will be looking to go big in this innings.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Very short and on middle. Kane stays low and pulls it away to deep square leg for four easily.
Fuller length this time, the batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground on the off side.
Short and on middle, Nicholls defends it on the back foot.

Elegant shot from the NZ skipper here, it was full and just outside off, he goes ahead and times it beautifully in the gap through the covers. It is a long chase for Azhar Ali who does well in the end to save one run for his team. There are plenty of replays being looked at before the umpire decides it's a legal stop.
Short and bowled a little wide off the crease, Williamson looks to punch it off the back foot but doesn't connect well.
Full and on off again, Kane will keep those out all day long.
Good length and on off stump. Williamson defends it with a straight bat.
Full on off stump, Nicholls comes ahead and defends it.
FOUR! Swept away this time. Outside off and flighted, Nicholls goes down early and sweeps it away behind square leg for another boundary. It also brings up the 50-run partnership between these two.

FOUR! Nice-looking shot from Nicholls. He stays back to a short pitched ball and punches it straight down the ground to long on for four runs. Sarfraz isn't too pleased with the mid on fielder's effort.
This one keeps low, ball is fuller and outside off. It turns in and keeps low on the stumps, Nicholls gets down in time and pulls it to square leg.
Good spin on this one, landing outside off and spins enough to beat Nicholls' bat who wants to defend it. He gets hit high on the pad. Pakistan appeal but aren't too vociferous.
Shorter length outside off, spins into Nicholls. He wants to push it to square leg but it hits forward short leg.
Fuller this time on off, Williamson defends it to mid on.
Length delivery and Abbas is pegging away at off stump, Williamson is unperturbed and defends again.
Good length on off stump, the NZ skipper just defends it back with a straight bat calmly.
Good length outside off and shaping in slightly, Williamson lets it go.
Slightly ahead this time on off stump, Williamson plays it to mid-wicket.
Short of a length on off, Williamson defends to cover off the back foot.
Mohammad Abbas to bowl some medium pace from the other end.
Way outside off, Nicholls prods well forward and defends it to short cover.
Slightly shorter, Nicholls goes back and defends off the back foot.
Full and outside off, the batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Loopy outside off again, Nicholls comes and sweeps it to fine leg for a couple. Little risky but plays it well in the end.
Around the wicket to the left-hander, looped up outside off, turns into Nicholls who comes ahead and defends.
First ball after Lunch is flighted outside off, Williamson drives it to covers for a single.
We are back for the afternoon session. Kane Williamson and Henry Nicholls will carry on from where they left off. Yasir Shah to take the ball first. A slip and a short leg in place.
... Day 1, Session 2 ...

Batting usually gets easier in the afternoon session, so New Zealand will look to score a bit freely. Though, they will remember that the ball is turning, so they have to be wary of the Pakistan spinners. Remember, it's an extended Lunch break due to the Friday prayers, so play will resume at 1330 local (0930 GMT).

A grinding session for New Zealand, and Pakistan too in all honesty. The surface didn't have much to offer, but despite that, Pakistan have managed to pick three wickets, which will particularly please them after losing the toss. Abbas started it all off by removing Raval first, Yasir joined in and got rid of both Latham and Taylor rather quickly. Williamson, who is looking quite assured as always, has since joined hands with Nicholls to put 81 on the board with their stand currently on 42.
Drifting in on a fuller length, around off, nicely negotiated by the left-hander. That's LUNCH ON DAY 1!
Watches the ball as it comes to him and blocks.
Nicholls has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Some flight on this, on off stump, Nicholls presses forward to meet it with  a straight bat.
Straighter in line, worked in front of short mid-wicket.
Quicker through the air around off, met with the full face of the bat.
Mohammad Hafeez is on now. Probably the last over before Lunch.
Full on the stumps, guarded out well.
Spinning in on middle and leg, easy enough for Henry to sweep it behind square leg for a single.
Goes with the spin and drives it through the gap in the covers. One run collected.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A touch shorter around off, Kane camps back and pushes it away from the body on the off side.
Starts from around the wicket, serves it around off and it spins away. Williamson leaves it alone.
Haris Sohail will roll his arm over.
Shifts his weight on the back foot and turns it to backward square leg.
Waits for the ball to come to him before guarding it out off the back foot.
Full outside off, Nicholls gets forward and across as he drags the sweep behind square leg. Wants the run but it's too close to the fielder.
Looped up leg break attacking the stumps, blocked right under his nose.
The umpire is checking the shape. Cuts off some of the threads off it and we're good to continue.
Knocks it into the covers and gets to the other end.
Pushed quicker through the air, on the stumps, from over the wicket. Kane prods forward and pushes it away.
FOUR! Too straight in line and it's put away. Tossed up on middle and leg, Nicholls gets low and sweeps it through the square leg area to send it across the boundary line.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Drifting in on middle and then turning away, some pace given to this. It is kept out from the back foot.
A lot of flight on this, on leg, swept down to fine leg for one.
Uses the depth of the crease to go inside and work it down in front of short leg.
Bilal continues from around the wicket, pitches it on off. Williamson backs away and punches it a bit square on the off side for a double.
Positions himself right behind the line of the ball and defends.
Goes with the spin and turns it away on the on side.
Spinning in from middle, it goes off Nicholls' pads and Imam at short leg takes the catch. Pakistan appeal, but to no avail.
From around the wicket, it's tossed up on middle and off. Spins in as the left-hander presses forward and buries it into the track.
Short and wide outside off, slapped through to sweeper cover for a run.
The physio is out to have a look at Imam. The magic spray is out. Should be fine to continue.

That must have hurt! Yikes! Williamson goes and pulls it with a lot of power. Unfortunately, catches Imam on the inside of the thigh. Lucky it wasn't a bit to his left, would have done some serious damage.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Similar kind of ball, it's defended down on the leg side once more.
Sliding in on middle and leg, Nicholls works it off his pads on the leg side.
Lovely. Really slow through the air, on off, spins away and beats the outside edge of Henry Nicholls' bat. Beaten in the flight.
A lot of air on this, landed on off, Henry is well forward in defense.
Flighted on the stumps from around the wicket, goes back and turns it with the spin past short leg for a single.
Nicholls tries to sweep again on a similar length delivery and finds the fielder again. No run.
Fuller and outside off, Nicholls sweeps it to short fine leg.
Shorter ball and turning into the left-hander, he defends off the back foot.
Goes around the wicket now, pitches outside off on a full length. Nicholls sweeps it in front of square on the leg side for a couple.
Full and fast on leg stump, Nicholls gets his bat ahead of his front pad and defends it.
On off stump and turning away but Kane gets down and paddle sweeps it towards fine leg. They run three.
Loopy delivery on off stump, Nicholls comes forward and defends it well.
Shorter ball on middle, the batsman goes back and defends it with a straight bat.
Flighted on off stump, Nicholls comes ahead and defends.
Slightly fuller this time but at the pads, Williamson works it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Even shorter this time, Williamson rocks back and pulls it but it goes straight to the fielder at square leg again.
Full and at the pads, played to short square leg.
Full and driven to deep extra cover for a run.
Short and spinning away outside off, Williamson cuts it straight to point.
Overpitched and played by Kane to the short mid-wicket fielder that's just been brought a little straighter.
Quicker delivery on off stump line, Williamson is quick to come ahead and block.
Fuller in length this time, KW defends from the front foot.
FOUR! Classic Williamson here! Flatter ball well outside off, but the Kiwi skipper flicks it to the deep mid-wicket boundary. Super shot.
Flighted on middle, Nicholls defends it after getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter again this time, the batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and quick outside off, the batsman is forward as he defends with a straight bat.
Flatter and quicker this time on middle, Nicholls goes back and defends.
Flighted outside off, draws Nicholls ahead but he defends well.
Short ball and on off stump, Williamson moves slightly inside the line and plays it to deep square leg for a run.
Flatter ball and on off, the batsman goes back and defends it comfortably.
Flighted outside off, Nicholls plays the cover drive against the spin and gets it in the gap for a couple of runs.
Full and flighted outside off, Nicholls comes ahead and dead-bats it.
Shorter and on the pads, defended off the back foot.

Short and wide outside off, Williamson looks to cut and the ball takes a thick edge and goes in the air to left of point. 'Catch it' is the shout from Sarfraz but it was pretty far away from the fielder. The batsmen pick up three.

FOUR! Flatter and quicker on the pads, Williamson picks up the length very quickly and rocks back. Flicks it away in front of square on the leg side for a beautiful boundary. Also brings up the 50 for New Zealand.
Shorter length on middle, bounces a little more and is defended from within the crease by the batsman.
Flatter ball and turns slightly, Nicholls defends on the back foot towards the off side.
Full and flighted, Nicholls comes ahead and defends with a straight bat.
Quicker ball on off stump, Nicholls stays back and defends it.
Loopy ball on off stump but turns in a bit and is played away behind square on the leg side for a single by the skipper.
Short and outside off, Williamson cuts it but it goes straight to point.
Bilal Asif is back into the bowling attack.
Flighted delivery to end the over, Nicholls comes forward and dead-bats it.
Flatter ball on middle, the batsman goes back and defends on the back foot this time.
Full and flighted outside off, Nicholls is well forward in defense.
FOUR! Nicholls charges down the wicket to a loopy delivery on middle and hits it over mid on cleanly. A boundary results.
Similar delivery, the batsman comes ahead and keeps it out.
Flighted on middle, Nicholls comes ahead and defends.
Second Drinks break of the session. In case you are wondering why, the first session in U.A.E on Fridays is slightly extended due to prayers and Lunch will be a one-hour break.
Slightly short of length and on top of off stump, Williamson defends to mid on.
Back to good length and slightly shaping in, Kane defends to cover.
Yorker length and outside off, Williamson digs it into the ground.
Good length and well outside off this time, the skipper lets it go through.
Good length and just outside off, Kane comes ahead and defends confidently.
Bouncer but wayward down the leg side, Williamson just ducks under it.
Loopy and full, landing on off, Henry is just a little tentative in getting on the front foot as he defends it towards mid-wicket.
An attempted googly on middle and off, a bit on the shorter side, Henry goes back in defense.
Lands it full and on off, Nicholls lunges and defends it watchfully.
Quicker through the air, flat and on middle, Nicholls gets back and blocks it.
Surrounded by four close-in fielders, Henry Nicholls. Still he keeps a calm head to a shortish ball and punches it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Flatter and shorter on off, Williamson goes back and punches it to sweeper cover for a run. He is showing to his batsmen that there isn't anything to worry about on this surface.
Alters his length this time and spears in a full ball on middle and off, Henry gets behind the line and pushes it out to covers.
Slightly short in length and angling into the batsman from outside off, Nicholls blocks it solidly to the off side.
Nice tempting line. Hasan pitches it up and outside off, inviting the drive but Henry lets it go to the keeper.
Switches to 'round the wicket and angles in a length ball on middle and off, Nicholls covers the line and blocks it safely.
Back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Nicholls goes on the back foot and defends.
Kane is timing his shots beautifully. Needless to say, he holds the key from hereon. Gets on the front foot to a full ball and drives it in the gap at covers for a run.

Appeal for an lbw! A tossed up ball on middle, turning back in at 83.3 kph, Nicholls prods forward to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. They put in an unsuccessful appeal. Later, Pakistan think about reviewing it but then decide against it. Good call. End of a successful over.
Henry Nicholls is in next.

OUT! Caught behind! Lovely bowling by the leggie and he has hunted down New Zealand's most experienced player. He once again gives it a nice loop and lands his leggie on a fuller length just outside off. Taylor, with a sorry footwork, feels for it inside the line and the ball spins away a bit to take the outside edge. Sarfraz makes no mistake behind the wickets and Taylor immediately walks back without even waiting for the decision. New Zealand slip further. Don't think there is much in the pitch to bother the batsmen but they are finding ways to get out due to improper application. Pakistan on top in this Test match. They wouldn't have wished for a better start after losing the toss.
Loopy and on off, a shade short in length, Kane pushes his weight on the back foot and punches it through the cover region for a run.
Once again Yasir gives it a good toss and lands it full on middle, Williamson defends it back from the inner half of the bat.
Extra flight this time, full and drifting in around off, Kane presses forward in defense.
Flighted delivery, on the shorter side around off, Taylor moves back and slaps it with the spin through point for a run.
Fractionally short and on off, Williamson rocks back and blocks it safely towards mid on. A maiden over.
This time the length is full and in line of the stumps, Williamson immediately gets behind the delivery and keeps it out safely towards mid-wicket.
Good length delivery on off, Kane goes on the back foot and pushes it towards the mid on fielder.
Brings a length ball back into the batsman from around off, Williamson stays back and closes the face of the bat to play it towards the mid-wicket fielder.
Back of a length delivery around off, Williamson goes on the back foot and punches it through the line. Finds the cover fielder. Looking quite good and composed at the crease, the Kiwi skipper.
Lands it on a good length outside off, holding its line, Kane watches the line closely and lets it be.
Flighted outside off, Taylor wants to drive but gets the inside half again and just pushes it to cover in the end.
Outside off and spins away, Taylor leaves it alone.
Slightly shorter, Taylor defends on the back foot.
Fuller on the pads this time, Taylor drives to mid on.
Flighted outside off, driven to short cover.
Quicker one on off stump, Taylor tries to cut but gets the inside half and goes back to the bowler.
Good length and shaping in again on off stump, Kane plays the back foot on drive to mid on.
Slightly fuller outside off, Williamson defends on the front foot.
Shorter this time outside off, Kane punches it towards point.
Length ball shaping in on off stump, the Kiwi skipper defends it comfortably.
Slightly fuller and outside off, Kane covers the line of the ball and defends it.
Good ball to start the  over, on a length and on the off stump line, well defended by Kane.
Looped right up there, Taylor brings his bat ahead of his pad and blocks it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Short and flat from the leggie, Kane is back as he whips this through mid-wicket for a single.
Darted in full on the stumps, jammed out well to keep it at bay.
Taylor rocks onto the back foot and punches it through to sweeper cover for one.
Spinning away from around off, Taylor looks to defend but it goes off the edge behind square on the off side.

Big shout for a leg before, turned down! Missing leg from the looks of it. Good variation from Hasan, fuller and on middle and shapes in after landing. Williamson looks to flick it and misses as the ball hits his pad. Sarfraz and the bowler consider reviewing but too much time has passed and they don't in the end. Lucky for them in hindsight, as the replays show the ball would've missed leg stump.
Shorter and outside off, Williamson plays it away to cover.
Pitching on off stump and shaping in slightly, Williamson isn't troubled. Defends it to short mid-wicket.
Just short of a good length outside off, Williamson cuts it straight to point this time. Well timed but no run.
Slightly fuller this time, Kane gets right behind the line of the ball and defends it.
Good length outside off, Williamson defends it safely to cover.
Hasan Ali is back on.
Flighted this time, Taylor comes ahead and dead-bats it into the ground.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Taylor defends off the back foot.
Ross Taylor is next in to bat.

OUT! Caught by Hafeez at short mid-wicket! A very soft dismissal to be honest. The ball is flighted on off and turns in a bit after landing, Latham is brought forward into a shot and plays it in the air towards mid-wicket. Hafeez is there to take the simplest of catches. He fumbled at first, but then managed to take it on the second attempt. A wicket thrown away by the New Zealand opener. Yasir is pumped up.
Shorter and on off stump, Latham stays back and defends.

Short and spinning quite a bit down the leg, huge appeal from the keeper and Yasir for caught behind. But the ball seems to have grazed the thigh pad before Sarfraz takes it. Umpire wants nothing to do with it.
Short one to start off with outside off stump, Kane cuts it to sweeper cover and picks up one.
Yasir Shah is into the attack now.
Flatter outside off this time, Kane rocks back and punches it through the covers for three.
Looped up outside off, dead-batted onto the ground.
Flighted on off, defended after coming ahead by KW.
FOUR! Quick feet from the skipper and the good length ball on off is flicked away through mid-wicket for his first boundary.
Looped up this time, kept out on the front foot.
Shorter and on off stump, Williamson flicks it to square leg.

The first Drinks of the match is on the field now! A very sedate start to the day by the Black Caps. Abbas has struck to dismiss Raval, but Latham and Williamson are looking good out there. The pitch is looking like a flat cement road and beautiful for batting. A long day for the bowlers and fielders seems to be in store!
Around the wicket to Latham, just ahead of a good length and on off stump. Latham comes ahead and defends with a straight bat.
Slightly full this time, and Williamson is off the mark with a flick through mid-wicket. The batsmen run three. Good running.
Length ball outside off, comes ahead and defends again.
Similar ball again, and well defended again by Williamson.
Good ball just outside off, Williamson is good in defense.
Good length aiming the top of off stump, Williamson defends solidly on the back foot.
FOUR! That's a very good shot from Tom Latham. Bilal loops it up on off stump, the southpaw leans into the shot and wrists it through the left of mid on for a boundary.
Rocks on the back foot and guards it out without much trouble.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Lands it short once more, Tom is on the back foot to keep this out.
A bit fuller around off, kept out from inside the crease.
Quicker off break outside off, short too, Latham goes back and forces it to covers.
A length ball which is in the channel just outside off, blocked by taking a step forward. Good over from Abbas comes to an end. A wicket maiden for him.
Shaping away from outside off, Kane makes a rather simple leave.
Brings it in a little, on middle this time, Williamson gets right behind the line and blocks it in the same area.
Fuller length delivery on off, Williamson defends it well towards mid-wicket.
Skipper Kane Williamson is in at no.3.

OUT! And he strikes! What a delivery from a superb bowler! Bowls it a tad fuller outside off, it's angling in at first but then it moves away ever so slightly. Raval is forced to play at it and is undone by the late movement. The edge is taken and it's a regulation take for captain Sarfraz Ahmed behind the stumps. Jeet Raval will be disappointed after putting in the hard work in the first 10 overs.
Fires it full and just outside off, driven to the covers.
On the shorter side of things again, it's played back to the bowler. End of the over. So, New Zealand have safely negotiated the first 10 overs.
Flatter and shorter outside off, guarded out safely.
Latham shoulders arms to let that one through.
Drifting in on off, turning away, Tom stays inside the crease and defends it down on the off side.
Well outside off, going away again, Tom Latham lets it be.
Quite slow through the air from around the wicket, spinning away outside off. No shot offered by Latham.
So this is smart by Raval. He's standing well outside the crease to deal with Abbas' swing. Works too, as he defends it a bit square on the off side.
On a length, on off, kept out from within the crease.
Full ball attacking the stumps, driven straight back in the bowler's direction.
Good length delivery outside off, left alone.
Full delivery outside off, a mistimed drive finds its way to the cover fielder.
Wow. That was close. Really close. Abbas bowls this full, makes it come in and then it goes away late. Raval has no option but to play at it. Comes forward, hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pushes this floated delivery through the cover area for a single.
A touch quicker through the air, around off, blocked.
Nicely tosses it up on middle and off, Raval brings his bat ahead of his pad and defends.
Slows this one up. Loops it up on off, Raval comes forward to keep it out.
Short, flat and quick on off, Raval goes back and punches it to the man at cover.
First bowling change for Pakistan. Bilal Asif is brought into the attack. The lone slip in place for him, along with a short leg.
Uses the angle into him to turn this away in front of square leg and get to the other end.
Coming in at first but then goes away, Jeet stays inside his crease and meets it with the full face.
Keeps it on the fuller side, around off, defensively pushed away to the cover area.
Angling in at first but then straightening up off the seam, worked straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
Full length delivery on off stump, blocked by taking a big stride forward.
Abbas continues from around the wicket and pitches it wide outside off, no way Jeet Raval is going to bother himself with that.
Shaping away from around off, Latham plants his front foot forward, covers the line and makes a watchful leave.
Outside off on a length, left alone.
A touch straight in line, turned away on the leg side with soft hands.
FOUR LEG BYES! Too straight from Hasan Ali, a length ball on leg. Latham looks to flick but it goes off his pads, past the diving keeper for a boundary.
Similar shot. Plays it through the covers to the man in the deep for two more.
Good timing on that. Latham offers a firm punch to this fuller length ball and finds the gap through the covers. Two runs result.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump once again. Good, tight over from Abbas.
Throws it outside off, Raval lets it go.
Switches the angle to around the wicket, angles in a length ball on off, forces Raval to play at this one. It is blocked.
Make that three in a row. Similar ball, same thing done by the batsman. Left alone.
Too far outside off this time, another leave.
Seeing the ball land outside the line of off stump, Jeet shoulders his arms to it.
Good carry on this occasion for Hasan Ali. He hurls it on a length in the off stump channel, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Outside off once more, another easy leave for the batsman.
Bowls it on the fifth stump line, Tom Latham covers the line, keeps his eyes on the ball and leaves it alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Angling away from Latham, he plays with the angle and taps it to the covers.
Length delivery attacking the off stick, patted away defensively on the off side.
A little too straight in line, it's clipped down to fine leg for one run.
Fraction straight in line, on a length, blocked down in front of square leg. Thinks about taking the single at first, but then decides against it.
Fullish in length, just outside off, met with the full face of the bat.
Good running between the wickets. Raval taps this down just wide of the short cover fielder and both batsmen hare across.
Keeps it around that off stump channel, Jeet raises his bat and lets it through.
Good length ball on the fourth stump line, quite close to the off stump, but Raval keeps his eyes on the ball and lets it be.
In the channel outside off, left alone to end the over.
FOUR! Shot. He'll feel good about that. Latham gets off the mark in style. It's full and outside off, he drives this well through the covers for a boundary. Good balance while playing that.
Outside off yet again, another easy leave.
Shaping away from the left-hander, from a good length and outside off, no shot offered to that.
On the fuller side of things, Latham comes on to the front foot and defends yet again.
Spears in a full delivery on off stump, Latham brings a straight blade down in defense.
Well... this is a surprise! Hasan Ali to share the new ball with Abbas from the other end. Three slips and a gully in place for him too.
That wasn't far away either! So close to the off stump. Abbas serves an accurate length delivery around off, Raval makes a watchful leave.
Just ahead of a length on this occasion, blocked with a straight blade in response.
Oooofff! Well hello! Superb delivery. Bowls it in that channel around off, on a length and it nips away late. Raval looks to defend it from the crease but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Another one in the channel outside off, Raval makes another leave.
Much better. Hits the good length area around off, Raval has nothing to do with it.

Four running runs! Fine way to start off! Full and just outside off, Raval leans into the shot and drives it crisply through the big gap in the covers. The fielder chases it down near the fence and by then the batsmen complete four runs. Not sure it has happened before in a Test match, four running runs off the first ball of a match.

We are ready to begin. Tom Latham and Jeet Raval make their way out to the middle, as the Pakistan team spreads out across the field taking their positions. Mohammad Abbas will take the new ball first up. Three slips and a gully in place for him. Let's roll...

TOSS - New Zealand win the toss and opt to bat first! An expected XI put out by Pakistan, with Hasan Ali getting a spot. Ajaz Patel will make his Test debut for New Zealand. Trent Boult, Neil Wagner and Colin de Grandhomme will be the seamers for the tourists, while Ish Sodhi and the debutant will take on the spin responsibilities.

A stern challenge awaits the Black Caps. Firstly, it will be interesting to see what combination they go with. Unlike Pakistan, who have a more or less settled XI, New Zealand have a few new faces to incorporate. The visitors are a balanced, competitive outfit, so the onus will be upon the experienced players in the Pakistan ranks to really step up. All in all, it should be a good contest. The toss and other updates to soon follow.

Hello and welcome for the opening Test between Pakistan and New Zealand. Pakistan have recently fared well in the longest format, having beaten Australia, and there's much to be excited about watching them on the field. That is largely down to their new-found star Mohammad Abbas. Him against some quality Kiwi batsmen will be a battle to witness, especially against someone like Kane Williamson.
